text:
The provided evidence is an abstract of a review article that summarizes conventional strategies and novel methods (such as microfluidics) for extracellular vesicle (EV) isolation, reviews commercially available kits, and assesses global market demand. It does not test or propose the integration of surface plasmon resonance imaging (SPRi) with size-exclusion chromatography (SEC) and antibody microarrays. Therefore, the evidence does not support the candidate hypothesis.

VERDICT: REJECT
